hypothesis: Native equal-time loss advantage transfers to both historical book excerpts and raw technical documentation; a reversal in either domain refutes the strong two-domain claim.

pg19_books.license: Apache-2.0 as declared by PG19 publisher

python_library_rst.format: raw UTF-8 reStructuredText, including markup/code; no rendering or prose-only extraction

selection.order: sort by SHA256(ASCII seed + newline + domain + newline + source name); ties by name
selection.excerpt_start: int(SHA256(ASCII seed + newline + domain + newline + source name + newline + window),16) modulo (full_token_count-3201+1)
selection.underfill: Reject whole panel if either domain has fewer than32 eligible documents. No smaller or substituted panel after scores.
selection.no_artificial_eot: Do not append EOT at artificial excerpt boundaries. Score3200 real targets after one first context token.
selection.tokenizer: tiktoken gpt2 encode_ordinary; no special-token interpretation; original frozen vocabulary/assets

deduplication.rule: Reject candidate excerpt if any contiguous32-token BLAKE2b-128 digest matches any within-document32-token span in original train or validation, or a previously selected excerpt in either domain. Never slide to another window after rejection.
deduplication.index: sorted unique16-byte digests; preserve index and bind its SHA256
deduplication.limitations: Exact token spans only. Shorter overlap, whitespace/case changes, paraphrases and overlaps outside the scored excerpt can remain. Hash matches conservatively exclude. Original test is not consulted.

inference.batch: same sequential document chunks as qualified scorer
inference.model_source_bindings: all sources from the frozen equal-time plan must still match

analysis.primary: token-weighted CE within each domain; equal-domain mean across both domains

bootstrap.sampling: 32 parent-document IDs with replacement independently within each of the two domains; same IDs paired across models; average three seed loss sums before resampling
bootstrap.multiplicity: Bonferroni four one-sided domain/direction claims at familywise1%; macro99% interval descriptive only

analysis.transfer_acceptance: For an arm: all three paired differences negative in each domain; each domain mean difference <=-0.02 nats/token; each domain adjusted upper bound <0. Require both domains. Symmetric rule; exact ties fail.
analysis.mixed_or_uncertain: Retain in-distribution decision and report domain-specific evidence without claiming broad transfer.
analysis.scope: Conditional on selected excerpts, domains, fixed checkpoints and three training seed pairs. No population-seed or general-competence claim.

admission: Source/selection/analysis rules frozen now before new text processing; scoring requires successful acquisition+dedup+loader qualification and exact bound-data/resource admission.
